v2_input_adaptation.funding_rate_bps: The V1 decimal funding rates are converted to V2 basis points at the model boundary.
v2_input_adaptation.funding_missing_margin_fallback_notional: Explicitly carries V1's fixed_live_entry_notional_quote=50.0 for the no-private-margin sidecar input; it is not copied from v1_expected.entry_notional_quote.

representation_only.entry_maker_leg: V2 enum-like lowercase text is compared with V1's capitalized label.
representation_only.first_funding_leg: V2 enum-like lowercase text is compared with V1's capitalized label.
representation_only.quantity: V2 entry_target_quantity is the same base-unit quantity represented as V1 quantity.

not_compared.v2_candidate_identity: V2 revision and lease identifiers have no V1 raw_output field and are not V1 business-result fields.
not_compared.v2_provenance_and_diagnostics: V2 observation, forecast, advisory, and diagnostic fields have no V1 raw_output counterpart.
not_compared.v2_execution_only_fields: V2 per-leg execution and contract-proof evidence are inputs or execution evidence, not emitted V1 oracle results.

compile_only_stubs: crate::rate_limit::RateLimitRuntime: compile-only placeholder for the real V1 runtime-injected execution manager behind a #[serde(skip)] field on RuntimeConfig. Not touched by discovery/config/market/liquidity/model semantics.
excluded_provider_submodules: opportunity_input exchange_only/live_scan/sidecar_backed/sidecar_scan/sidecar_snapshot/source_backed: live-data fetch executors not on the executed discovery path; their types are excluded. The opportunity-input types discovery reads (OpportunityInputSnapshot, PairedOpportunityInput, OpportunityInputAcquisitionMode, ...) are included verbatim from real opportunity_input/types.rs.
